lineConvention: One-based baseline lines; unchanged relevant product files on latest branch. Latest CI lines are baseline+25.

findings.title: Healthy exclusively locked catalog is restored from stale backup
findings.trigger: Another connection holds an exclusive SQLite lock while recoverIfNeeded performs its open-time quick_check.
findings.effect: SQLITE_BUSY is collapsed to corruption; the healthy live database is set aside and replaced with an older snapshot. Reopened rating fell from 5 to 1.
findings.scopeLimit: Ordinary WAL writes are not claimed to trigger this; original DB is retained as .damaged-* and is recoverable. Other transient errors use the same code branch but were not independently injected.

repro.expected: Return unavailable/busy and leave live catalog untouched
repro.observed: error 5 database is locked; outcome restored; rating 5 to 1

findings.testBlindSpot: Recovery tests cover corrupt/missing databases, not healthy-but-unavailable databases.
findings.recommendation: Use a tri-state integrity result and recover only after confirmed corruption, never from operational failure.

findings.title: New same-basename RAW sibling inherits another photo's sidecar edits
findings.trigger: Edit lone DSC_0001.DNG, then add DSC_0001.NEF and register/reopen folder.
findings.effect: Bare DSC_0001.xmp switches ownership from DNG to NEF. New NEF receives DNG exposure +2; DNG's newly expected qualified sidecar is absent.
findings.scopeLimit: A transition in folder membership is required; static collision combinations alone may behave as designed.
findings.testBlindSpot: Sidecar naming tests assert static sets, not transitions after edits are already written.
findings.newVsKnown: new transition failure beyond known collision fixes
findings.recommendation: Track ownership/provenance and migrate safely, or refuse ambiguous sidecar reassignment.

findings.title: Already-present ingest certifies matching truncated source and destination
findings.trigger: Source shrinks after a 5000-byte plan, and destination already contains the same 100-byte prefix.
findings.effect: Already-present shortcut bypasses planned-length guard. allVerified=true and reported bytesCopied=5000 for two 100-byte files.
findings.testBlindSpot: Short-read tests use a fresh destination; matching existing-destination branch returns before that validation.
findings.newVsKnown: new bypass of previously fixed fresh-copy short-read issue
findings.recommendation: Require digest byteCount to match planned byteCount before accepting alreadyPresent.

findings.title: Export final publication overwrites a file created during rendering
findings.evidenceLevel: dynamic real GPU export with sentinel race
findings.trigger: Another writer creates the selected free destination after batch disambiguation but before renderer publication.
findings.effect: replaceItemAt silently replaces that file even though normal batch workflow intends disambiguation.
findings.scopeLimit: Pre-existing files present before selection are correctly renamed; race requires another writer/concurrent export.

repro.observed: Sentinel replaced by 859-byte JPEG with FFD8FF header

findings.testBlindSpot: Pure disambiguation checks do not inject a competing final-path creation during the long render.
findings.newVsKnown: new; contradicts completeness of prior OUT-04 preflight guard verification
findings.recommendation: Separate explicit replace mode from batch no-replace publication; atomically claim or re-disambiguate final output.

findings.title: Sidecar sibling resolution makes folder registration quadratic
findings.evidenceLevel: source complexity plus optimized real CatalogService benchmark
findings.trigger: Register a large flat folder, including all-JPEG folders without sidecars.
findings.effect: Approximately four complete sibling-name passes per photo before applyScan; 500 tiny files took 22.93 seconds cold and 18.73 seconds repeat in optimized service harness.
findings.scopeLimit: Timings were under audit-session load, not controlled SLA tests. Main AppState lines shift on latest, but catalog/naming implementation is unchanged.

repro.observed: 500 optimized service files 22.93/18.73 seconds; isolated exact sibling loop scales quadratically

findings.testBlindSpot: Small folder/unit examples and cached directory listing do not expose repeated per-photo full-list scanning.
findings.newVsKnown: new measured root cause for known LIB-25 first-grid performance concern
findings.latestBranchStatus: persists; catalog and naming source identical
findings.recommendation: Build one stem index per directory, bypass sibling work for non-RAWs, memoize per-photo sidecar path and make registration supersedable.

findings.title: Replacing an original at its URL retains stale source pixels, preview and quick signature
findings.evidenceLevel: dynamic catalog and unchanged RenderCoordinator source cache
findings.trigger: External file replacement/edit at a URL already scanned and decoded in the session.
findings.effect: Changed scan keeps old quickSig and previews; source object continues rendering original pixels/dimensions until explicit invalidation or eviction.

repro.observed: 32x24 red sample unchanged until explicit invalidate; old signature and preview row survive rescan

findings.testBlindSpot: Recipe-driven invalidation/eviction tests do not simulate a new source generation at one URL.
findings.recommendation: Track source generation and invalidate all source-dependent catalog/cache layers when size/mtime/content changes.

findings.title: Old developed preview receives a newer recipe fingerprint
findings.evidenceLevel: dynamic unchanged ThumbnailLoader, PreviewStore and CatalogService scheduling
findings.trigger: recordDeveloped queues old rendered pixels, then a newer recipe saves before its unstructured task queries current catalog state.
findings.effect: Old pixels are durably indexed as the new recipe and served as current.

repro.expected: Old fingerprint or refused stale publication
repro.observed: Exposure-0 image stored under exposure-2 fingerprint xxh64:e4ce9920b7023b16; served as current

findings.testBlindSpot: Tests assert rung dimensions and fingerprint equality but not render-result provenance across async suspension.
findings.recommendation: Carry exact source generation and recipe fingerprint from render request/result into preview recording; reject superseded publication.

findings.title: Catalog backup publishes final DB before blob backup can fail
findings.evidenceLevel: dynamic backup error injection and backup-alone restoration through real CatalogService
findings.trigger: A stored brush blob is unreadable or its backup copy otherwise fails after DB snapshot completes.
findings.effect: Final .db remains restore-eligible although paired .blobs lacks payload; real recovery restores brush recipe reference with zero payloads and an empty mask.
findings.scopeLimit: Backup-only restoration into fresh audit directory; no sidecar import first. A small available sidecar can independently rescue payloads. Live audit catalog and originals remain intact.

repro.expected: No final snapshot eligible until entire set succeeds
repro.observed: Final .db restored with recipe brush reference, zero payloads; 128x128 mask sum 18.56348 before and 0 after

findings.testBlindSpot: DB backup and blob backup tests do not fail the second step after DB publication.
findings.recommendation: Publish atomic complete snapshot bundles/manifests; reject incomplete candidates and clean failed unpublished sets.

findings.title: Sidecar write failure never invokes visible failure reporting
findings.trigger: Atomic sidecar write fails; in repro its expected path is an audit-owned directory.
findings.effect: Log-only retry occurs, no onFailure callback; final quit flush can fail without user knowing portable sidecar was not saved.
findings.scopeLimit: Catalog save succeeds; no active DB edit loss claimed. Permissions/full disk analogous but not separately injected.

repro.expected: Visible persistent failure / failed quit-flush warning
repro.observed: NSError logged, onFailureMessages=[], sidecar still directory

findings.testBlindSpot: Successful sidecar round trips do not cover UI error propagation or end-of-process retry impossibility.
findings.recommendation: Persist and show failed sidecar-save state; surface final flush failure and allow retry.

findings.title: JPEG encoder writes 72 PPI despite requested 240 PPI
findings.confidence: high observed mismatch; medium encoder precedence cause
findings.evidenceLevel: dynamic actual encode and ImageIO readback
findings.trigger: Export synthetic JPEG source at 240 PPI, with either retained or stripped EXIF.
findings.effect: JPEG reads 72 PPI while HEIC/TIFF/PNG read 240; physical placement/print density is wrong, pixel count is unchanged.

repro.observed: JPEG 72 PPI including nested TIFF density; other formats 240

findings.testBlindSpot: Metadata dictionary tests do not reopen actual encoded file and assert its canonical/nested density.
findings.newVsKnown: known OUT-05 unverified area, now experimentally confirmed
findings.recommendation: Reconcile nested density and encoder options; add real JPEG readback tests.

findings.title: Supplied Contact metadata is absent in JPEG, HEIC, TIFF and PNG output
findings.evidenceLevel: dynamic actual encode plus property and metadata-tag readback
findings.trigger: Enter contact and copyright and export supported formats.
findings.effect: Copyright survives; contact is missing in all tested outputs, including full JPEG/TIFF metadata tags.
findings.scopeLimit: UI includes an unverified-metadata warning; this is unfinished/broken functionality, not concealed proof of full privacy compliance.

repro.expected: Supplied contact available in delivered metadata

findings.testBlindSpot: Dictionary insertion with IPTCContact does not prove encoder serialization; no real readback assertion.
findings.newVsKnown: known OUT-05 unverified area, now experimentally confirmed
findings.recommendation: Use format-supported contact/XMP representation with real round trips, or disable the field until implemented.

findings.title: Test failures do not gate the automatic update release
findings.confidence: high for ungated publication; branch race source-inferred
findings.trigger: A build succeeds while tests fail/time out, or two publishing branches complete competing runs.
findings.effect: Independent app-bundle job publishes to auto-installed dev-latest regardless of tests; both branches share feed and dates do not enforce ancestry.
findings.scopeLimit: No remote write, malicious package, live install or branch race was executed. This is an intentional development release policy, not an exploit demonstration.

repro.case: CI dependency and updater decision audit
repro.observed: No needs test gate; main and Claude branch publish same dev-latest; quiet check installs eligible release

findings.testBlindSpot: Passing updater decision unit tests cannot enforce missing CI dependency/channel promotion policy.
findings.recommendation: Separate experimental artifacts from auto-update releases, require tests/proof, restrict publishing branch and serialize monotonic feed promotion.
